en: The image shows an old photograph of a busy urban street lined with several-story buildings on each side. People in early 20th-century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and some are standing in the street. The street is broad and appears to be unpaved or under construction. The trees along the street are bare, suggesting it might be winter. The image has a sepia tone, typical of early postcards. At the top of the image, there is printed text indicating the location.
